technique_name: Describe in detail the 3D printer challenges
description: 3D printers have wide-ranging applications in many industries, from printing prototypes and industry-specific parts to conducting research and development. However, 3D printing presents many challenges that must be overcome in order for it to be used in commercial and industrial settings. These challenges include the cost of production, design limitations, safety issues, and copyright issues. Cost of production is an especially critical challenge; 3D printing can be more expensive than tradition
